newsitem.title: USA: Johnson & Johnson buys Calif. laser maker.
newsitem.headline: Johnson & Johnson buys Calif. laser maker.

text.p: Johnson & Johnson said Monday it is buying Indigo Medical Inc, a portable diode laser system manufacturer based in Palo Alto, California for undisclosed terms.

Indigo markets diode lasers in Europe to treat benign prostatic hyperplasia, and the company is seeking marketing clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for treating benign prostatic hyperplasia in the U.S., Johnson & Johnson said.
Prostatic hyperplasia is a prostate disorder that hinders urination. Johnson said the condition affects 20 million men worldwide.

Indigo was formed in 1990 with the help of Johnson & Johnson Development Corp, Lovelace Scientific Resources and the Air Force Phillips Labs to research thermotherapy treatments for urologic disease, Johnson & Johnson said.
